shared_elements: abstract geometric motifs carved in low relief/incision on a curved surface
linear incised lines covering part of the surface
justification: The only correspondence is the very generic one that both surfaces carry schematic, non-representational carved motifs: A shows discs, rings and curved bands plus a crescent-like arc, B shows dense hatched triangles and zigzag panels, and these are not the same motifs. Decisively different in content overall: A is a monumental anthropomorphic figure with a face, ears, arms and torso carrying its ornament, whereas B has no figural imagery at all, only an all-over field of geometric hatching.
